chunks: From him, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ al-Nakhaʿī, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about rukūʿ and sujūd: how much tasbīḥ is sufficient in them? He said: Three, and one suffices for you if you have firmly placed your forehead upon the ground.

key_terms.التَّسْبِيحِ: the glorification formula recited in worship
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground, upon which the forehead is placed in prostration
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةٌ: three repetitions, indicating the fuller prescribed amount
key_terms.جَبْهَتَكَ: your forehead, whose placement is required in sajdah
key_terms.وَاحِدَةٌ: one repetition, indicating the minimum sufficient amount

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum tasbīḥ that suffices in rukūʿ and sujūd according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum amount of tasbīḥ sufficient in rukūʿ and sujūd. It indicates that saying it three times is the standard, while one utterance is sufficient for validity when the sajdah is properly performed with the forehead placed on the ground.
